授業目的: The purpose of this course is two-fold: 1. To provide students with the basic knowledge related to bilingualism including its definition, roles that languages play in society, various routes to bilingualism, bilingualism and its effect on cognition, theories of bilingualism and their influence on school curriculum for bilingual children, various types of education for bilingual children.  2. To provide students with the chance to think about bilingualism and bilingual education from a sociopolitical/critical perspective.  Topics of discussion include bilingualism and bilingual education as a problem, right, and resource.  We will also look at the relationship between bilingualism/bilingual education and ideology, identity, and enpowerment.
到達目標: By taking this course, students will be able to obtain the basic knowledge related to bilingualism including various views of bilingualism, the status quo of bilingualism, development types of bilingualism, and bilingualism and its cognitive advantages.  They will also be able to understand theories of bilingualism, develop understanding of education that embraces bilingualism and bilingual children, and lastly raise awareness and understanding of the importance of bilingualism and bilingual education from a critical perspective.
授業の概要・背景: This course comprises two main parts: scientific study of bilingualism/bilingual education and sociopolitical/critical study of bilingualism and bilingual education.
授業方法: Each class meeting starts with small group discussion followed by class discussion and lecture.  Please be ready to participate actively in all the discussions and share your opinions and experiences.
